description: Look up cocktails in TheCocktailDB, the open, crowd-sourced drinks database. Search by name or first letter, pull a drink's full recipe with its ingredients, measures, glassware, photos and instructions in seven languages, and browse by ingredient, category, glass or alcoholic status (including a 'what can I make with these' search across several ingredients at once). Also lists every category, glass, ingredient and alcoholic classification, and serves random, latest and popular drink picks.
